checks.name: redacted-consent-summary
checks.run:
from mission_control.drive_flow_contract import summary
r=summary([],0)
assert isinstance(r,dict) and r['flows']==[] and r['scope_of_result']=='CONSENT_PROGRESS_ONLY'
assert r['connected_account']=='NOT_ASSESSED' and 'modification permission' in r['permission_summary']

checks.name: immutable-flow-context-digest
checks.run:
from mission_control.drive_flow_contract import binding
r=dict(id='synthetic',app_id='sample-one',manifest_version=1,connection_id=None,connection_version=0,state_hash='a'*64,expires=600,data={'port':8768})
a=binding(r)
assert isinstance(a,str) and len(a)==64
assert a!=binding(dict(r,manifest_version=2)), 'App revision must be part of protected context'
